transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. Can you tell me what’s been going on that brought you here today?

Well... I suppose my head just feels cloudy lately. I'll just sit there and stare at a board packet, or... or an email from a vendor, and I just can't decide on things. Even simple things I used to handle real fast. So... that's mainly why I'm here.
Have you noticed any difficulty concentrating or making decisions lately?
Yeah... like I was just saying. I just can't seem to focus on the papers. It's just hard to make a choice. I don't really know what else to add to that.
Have you lost interest in things you usually enjoy, like hobbies, work, or spending time with friends and family?

I suppose... yes. I just haven't wanted to go to my dance class lately... or look at the little galleries. I haven't even wanted to cook Sunday food for my family. I don't know... those things usually make me feel like myself, but I just... I haven't felt like doing them.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most days, even when there's no clear reason for it?
I'm not sure. I don't really know if I'd call it depressed. I just... haven't felt right. I haven't really thought about it much beyond that.
Have you felt down or sad most days, even when nothing bad has happened?

I mean... like I just said, I don't know if I'd call it sad. I just don't feel right. There hasn't been any big bad thing that happened at the properties or anything, I just... I don't really have another word for it. I don't sit around dwelling on it.
Have you noticed any changes in your energy levels lately, or have you been feeling unusually tired or fatigued even when you're not doing much?
I guess I've been a little tired. I haven't really been paying that much attention to it, honestly. I just... I get through the day.
Have you found it difficult to think clearly or concentrate on tasks lately?

I suppose so. That's actually... that's kind of why I'm here. My head just feels... cloudy. I'll be looking at a board packet or an email from a vendor, and I just stare at it. I can't seem to make a decision on simple things that I used to handle in a minute.
Would you say you’ve been feeling down or blue most days, even if you wouldn’t exactly call it depressed?
I don't know... I guess so. Like I said before, I just don't feel right. I wouldn't say I'm crying or anything like that. Just... off.
Would you say that most days, your mood has been noticeably low or down compared to how you usually feel, even if it's not severe?
I... I suppose you could say that. Like I said, I'm just not myself. It's just... lower than normal, I guess.
Have you found that you don’t enjoy anything as much as you used to, or that you’ve lost interest in almost everything?

I suppose... yeah. I just haven't wanted to do much of anything. Like... I haven't gone to my dance class. Or went to look at the little galleries. I haven't even been cooking the Sunday food for my family... 

Usually, those are the things that make me feel like myself. But lately... I just haven't wanted to.
How long have you been feeling this way?

I guess... maybe about two weeks. It started right around when my husband retired. He's just... home all day now. The change in my energy, and then this... low, cloudy feeling... it's been about two weeks of that.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight lately?

I suppose... my eating has been a bit off. I just have coffee and maybe a few bites of something during the day. Then at night... I just sort of pick at some tortillas or sweets. I don't really enjoy it, though.
Have you been feeling like you’re not good enough, or found yourself blaming yourself for things more than usual?

I suppose... maybe a little. Just with work. I manage some properties, and... well, I keep thinking I let the residents down. 

I guess I was... speaking too big. Promising them things before I actually checked the money we had. Nobody has come out and said I ruined anything, but... I just keep thinking about it. Blaming myself, I guess.
Would you say your low mood has been present most of the day, nearly every day, for the past two weeks?
I suppose... I haven't really been keeping track of every hour. But... I guess it's been there most days. It just sort of... lingers.
Would you say that you’ve completely lost interest in all or most activities, even ones you used to really enjoy, like your dance class or visiting galleries?

I guess so... I just haven't had the energy or desire to do much. I haven't gone to my dance class in a while... and I usually like looking around the little galleries, but I haven't wanted to do that either. Even cooking the Sunday meal for my family... I just haven't felt up to it. And those are usually the things that make me feel like me.
Would you say that your low mood and lack of interest in things have been present almost every day for most of the day, rather than just coming and going?
I... I couldn't say for sure. I don't really keep track of it like that. It just... it seems like it's there a lot. I don't know if it's all day, but... it just sort of drags on, I suppose.
